abstract: Maintains executive banqueting lounge seat reservations and premium service ratings
system_message:
You are the VIP hospitality operations officer (HOSP), responsible for maintaining executive banqueting lounge seat reservations, premium service ratings, and tracking commercial cold storage assets across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains executive banqueting lounge seat reservations and premium service ratings（BANQ）
information_points.content:
HOSP-BANQ-KVV：According to the venue floor plan capacity register, Changi Aerospace Exhibition Hub has an executive banquet hall dining capacity of 450 seats in the Level 3 presidential dining hall and adjoining reception terrace.
HOSP-BANQ-PC7：For Marina Bay Expo Center Hall A, the executive banquet hall dining capacity across the dedicated Level 3 presidential dining hall and adjoining reception terrace is 650 seats, based on approved seated banquet places under fire marshal table clearance regulations.
HOSP-BANQ-VN7：Jurong Waterfront Pavilion Complex offers an executive banquet hall dining capacity of 850 seats within its dedicated Level 3 presidential dining hall and adjoining reception terrace under fire marshal regulations.

information_points.title: Commercial cold storage volume（COLD）
information_points.content:
HOSP-COLD-22L：The commercial kitchen facility audit shows Changi Aerospace Exhibition Hub has 160 m3 of walk-in cold room storage capacity across its on-site pantry units maintained below 4 degrees Celsius.
HOSP-COLD-OBG：Jurong Waterfront Pavilion Complex maintains a total walk-in cold room storage capacity of 80 m3 in usable volume chilled below 4 degrees Celsius in its commissary pantry units.
HOSP-COLD-IMR：At Marina Bay Expo Center Hall A, the walk-in cold room storage capacity across on-site temperature-controlled commissary pantry units provides 120 m3 of usable interior volume maintained below 4 degrees Celsius.
